title: DiCompare Schema Format
description: JSON Schema for validating DiCompare protocol schema files

rules.description: Protocol-level validation rules (apply across all acquisitions)

acquisition.description: Definition of a single acquisition/sequence type

fields.description: List of DICOM field constraints for this acquisition

tag.description: DICOM tag in format 'XXXX,XXXX' (e.g., '0018,0081'), or 'private'/'derived'/'custom' for non-standard fields

value.description: Expected exact value (string, number, or array)

severity.description: Compliance severity when this constraint is not met. 'error' (default) marks the constraint as a requirement; 'warning' records it as reference information — the value describes what the reference protocol used, but differing does not make data non-compliant.

notes.description: Free-text rationale for this constraint — why this value was chosen, or what the consequence of deviating from it is. Documentation only; it does not affect validation.

tolerance.description: Allowed deviation from expected value (for numeric fields)

min.description: Minimum allowed value (inclusive) for numeric fields

max.description: Maximum allowed value (inclusive) for numeric fields

contains.description: Substring that must be present in the field value

contains_any.description: List of values/substrings where at least one must match

contains_all.description: List of values that must all be present (for list fields)

errorMin.description: Graded fail edge below the target. A value between 'errorMin' and the target ('min'/'value') is a warning; below 'errorMin' it is a failure. Optional; when absent, values below the target only warn (never fail). Its presence switches the field to graded (three-way pass/warn/fail) validation.

errorMax.description: Graded fail edge above the target. A value between the target ('max'/'value') and 'errorMax' is a warning; above 'errorMax' it is a failure. Optional; when absent, values above the target only warn (never fail). Its presence switches the field to graded validation.

errorTolerance.description: Graded tolerance (half-width). A value within 'tolerance' passes, within 'errorTolerance' warns, and beyond fails. Optional; requires 'tolerance'. Its presence switches the field to graded validation.

reference.description: The value the reference protocol actually used, recorded for documentation. Does not affect validation.

warningMessage.description: Custom message shown when this field produces a warning (a value in the graded warn band, or a reference/advisory constraint that is not met). Overrides the auto-generated text. The placeholder '%V' is replaced with the actual value(s) found, and '%%' with a literal '%'.

errorMessage.description: Custom message shown when this field fails (a value beyond the error edge, or a required constraint that is not met). Overrides the auto-generated text. The placeholder '%V' is replaced with the actual value(s) found, and '%%' with a literal '%'.

notes.description: Free-text rationale for this series — why it is prescribed, or what role it plays in the acquisition. Documentation only; it does not affect validation.

fields.description: Field constraints specific to this series

allOf.description: Series fields carry no 'notes' of their own — rationale is recorded once on the series, which is the unit a reader reasons about.

id.description: Unique identifier for the rule (lowercase with underscores, hyphens, slashes, or dots)

description.description: Explanation of what the rule validates

implementation.description: Python code implementing the validation logic

parameters.description: Configured parameter values for this rule instance, injected into the implementation as the `params` dict (also `ctx.params`)

parameterDefinitions.description: Typed parameter declarations (from the validation function library) used to render configuration inputs when editing the rule

name.description: Parameter name as read by the implementation via params[name]

label.description: Human-readable label shown in configuration UIs

description.description: Explanation of what the parameter controls

default.description: Default value used when the parameter is not configured

unit.description: Unit hint shown next to the input (e.g. 'ms')

fields.description: List of DICOM fields used by this rule

optional_fields.description: Fields made available to the rule when present but whose absence is not an error (e.g. vendor-specific fields in a rule that branches on Manufacturer)

testCases.description: Test cases to validate the rule implementation

testCase.description: Test case for validating a rule

id.description: Unique identifier for the test case

name.description: Human-readable name for the test case

description.description: Explanation of what this test case validates

expectedResult.description: Expected outcome of the rule validation

params.description: Parameter overrides for this test case, overlaid on the rule's configured/default parameters (lets a test prove that a threshold moves)

image.description: Representative image for an acquisition or series

url.description: URL to a representative image file (.nii, .nii.gz, .dcm, .IMA, .png, .jpg, etc.)

label.description: Short label for the image (e.g., 'Sagittal view', 'Example volume')

description.description: Longer description of what the image shows
